sources.title: evaluation/suites/recipes/allergens.json — ingredient class table and diet claim definitions
sources.what_it_shows: Shared allergen/diet vocabulary: restriction classes gluten, dairy, egg, soy, peanut, tree_nut, sesame, fish, shellfish; flesh/meat classes for FSIS safety; markers animal_product and honey; claim forbids-sets for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free. This table's class vocabulary and restriction semantics follow it exactly (SCHEMA.md records it as the shared contract).

sources.what_it_shows: Chart rows: baking powder -> soda + cream of tartar / soured milk / vinegar / molasses; whole egg equivalents; half-and-half -> 7/8 cup milk + 3 tbsp butter or 1 cup evaporated milk; heavy cream -> 3/4 cup milk + 1/3 cup butter; condensed milk builds; buttermilk -> milk + vinegar or yogurt; sour cream -> yogurt; sugar -> honey (3/4 cup, reduce liquid 1/4 cup) / corn syrup / molasses / brown sugar; honey -> 1 1/4 cups sugar + 1/4 cup water; flour thickener -> 1/2 tbsp cornstarch/potato/rice/arrowroot or 1 tbsp tapioca; shortening -> 7/8 cup lard / 1 1/8 cups butter; butter -> 7/8 cup oil; chocolate 1 oz -> 3 tbsp cocoa + 1 tbsp fat; semisweet 1 oz -> 1/2 oz baking chocolate + 1 tbsp sugar; cocoa 1/4 cup -> 1 oz baking chocolate; cornstarch 1 tbsp -> 2 tbsp flour or tapioca; lemon juice 1 tsp -> 1/2 tsp vinegar; allspice; pumpkin pie spice.

sources.publisher: Purdue University Extension FoodLink (Cheryl H. Armstrong, MBA, RD, CD)
sources.title: Recipe Substitutions — Top 20 Healthy Recipe Ingredient Substitutions
sources.what_it_shows: Equal-amount healthy swaps: whole egg -> 2 egg whites (bake half-and-half), 2% milk -> skim, heavy cream -> evaporated skim (soups/casseroles) or light cream/half-and-half (baking), buttermilk -> skim + lemon, sour cream/yogurt -> lowfat, cream cheese -> light, cottage/ricotta -> lowfat, butter -> margarine (light margarines toughen), cheese fat trims, 1 oz baking chocolate -> 3 tbsp cocoa + 2 tsp sugar + 1 tbsp oil, 1 cup chocolate chips -> 1/2 cup minis, oil in quick breads -> half puree + half oil or buttermilk, mayonnaise -> light.

sources.publisher: University of Wyoming Extension (Vicki Hayman, MS)
sources.title: No Milk? Milk Substitutes
sources.what_it_shows: Ten milk stand-ins with use notes: evaporated milk 1:1 with water; dry milk reconstituted; cream or half-and-half diluted 60/40 with water (half-and-half 1:1); canned coconut milk (coconut flavor); yogurt 1:1 (thin Greek with water; kefir 1:1); sour cream equal amount (regular or reduced-fat, not nonfat — separates); buttermilk 1:1; sweetened condensed (baked goods only, cut sugar); non-dairy milks (nut, oat, rice, soy) equal quantities, unsweetened; water + 1 1/2 tsp melted butter per cup.

sources.title: Egg Substitutes for Cooking and Baking (PDF)
sources.what_it_shows: 1/4 cup mashed ripe banana per egg; best for moist cakes, muffins, pancakes.

sources.title: Baking With Egg Substitutes
sources.what_it_shows: One egg is about 1/4 cup; fruit purees suit eggs as binder or moisture in cakes, cupcakes, muffins, brownies; not recipes relying on eggs for lift.

sources.title: The effect of avocado puree as fat replacer on the physical quality of muffin
sources.what_it_shows: Butter replaced with avocado puree at 25/50/75/100% in muffins: no significant differences in weight, height, hardness, cohesiveness, chewiness.

sources.title: Physical Properties and Microstructure of Butter Cake Added with Avocado Puree
sources.what_it_shows: Butter cake with 10/30/50% avocado puree: lower volume, larger cells, harder chewier crumb (avocado does not cream).

sources.title: Healthy Baking Ingredient Swaps
sources.what_it_shows: Brownies, chocolate cookies, chocolate cakes can swap 1 cup pureed avocado for 1 cup butter.

sources.title: Quantitative Assessment of Citric Acid in Lemon Juice, Lime Juice, and commercially-available juice products
sources.what_it_shows: Citric acid 1.44 g/oz (lemon) vs 1.38 g/oz (lime): interchangeable for acidity at 1:1; aroma differs.

sources.title: Zucchini noodles are a nutritious pasta alternative

sources.what_it_shows: Aquafaba replaces egg whites in French meringue; foams give similar sensory/textural results with slightly higher moisture — peer-reviewed function evidence for aquafaba as egg-white replacer.

sources.title: Chickpea aquafaba as an egg white substitute in vegan meringues (peer-reviewed, PMC9957096)
sources.what_it_shows: Chickpea cooking liquid whips into meringue-like foams replacing egg white in vegan meringues — function evidence (foaming), ratio recipe-defined.

sources.title: Fava-bean aquafaba and inulin as egg replacers in vanilla muffins
sources.what_it_shows: Legume aquafaba used as egg replacer in muffins (binder/moisture function in batters).

sources.title: Substitution evidence harness: pairs.snapshot.json (27 production pairs), pair_evidence.csv, sources.csv
sources.what_it_shows: The app's 27 shipped pairs with their production ratios and the evidence verdicts per pair (sourced/partial/unsupported, supported and unsuitable functions, cited sources, assessments). This table reuses those verdicts verbatim: sourced rows keep their sources, partial rows become convention, and rows with no sources or assessment stay unknown. Conflict records: egg->mashed banana (shipped 0.6 vs supported ~1.2) and honey->banana (1.5 ships, ~one fifth of the sugar).
